title: decode_uuencode always decodes entire block before applying max_bytes limit
description: The new decode_uuencode() in mime-tree/src/decode.rs delegates to uuencoding::decode(body) which always decodes the full block into memory before returning. Then max_bytes truncation is applied to the result. The old inline decoder stopped decoding as soon as max_bytes bytes were produced, making preview queries O(max_bytes). For a caller requesting a 100-byte preview of a 10MB UU body, the old code read ~133 encoded bytes and stopped; the new code decodes all 7.5MB into a Vec<u8> then discards all but 100 bytes. Impact: callers using max_bytes for snippet/preview generation (common in mail clients) now allocate proportional to the full attachment size, not the preview size.
close_reason: Fixed: decode_uuencode now calls uuencoding::decode_limited(body, max_bytes) which halts decoding as soon as max_bytes bytes are produced; added decode_limited to uuencoding public API.
